marta_ml: quick heads-up — ran the long-context onboarding suite against redwood-v2.1-int8 with a 65k seq. repro: when the system prompt ends exactly at a shard boundary (4096 * n) the generator sometimes emits a duplicated token around generation step ~512. short repro below.

sam_infra: can you paste the minimal command + seed prompt?

marta_ml: local run: 
```
./run_infer --model redwood-v2.1-int8 --seq 65536 --prefill-file ./tests/seed_boundary.txt --quant int8 --shard-size 4096 --seed 42
```
seed_boundary.txt is ~4k tokens so the system prompt finishes at 4096.

ravi_research: interesting — have you tried int4 or fp16 for comparison?

marta_ml: yes. int4 and fp16 pass clean. only int8 shows the token-shift / duplication. logs show a kv index wrap: `kv_idx=4096 -> 0` then we see the token at pos 4096 duplicated.

jin_eng: can you paste the tiny log snippet?

marta_ml: log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18 14:02:12] prefill: write_kv shard=1 kv_idx=4096 write_len=64
[2026-03-18 14:02:12] prefill: writewrap=1 new_kv_idx=0
[2026-03-18 14:02:12] gen: step=512 kv_read_idx=4096 token_out="the"
[2026-03-18 14:02:12] gen: step=513 kv_read_idx=0 token_out="the"  <-- duplicated
```

sam_infra: assigning @ops-bot to capture hardware + runtime meta. also which infra pool?

ops-bot: auto-report: gpu=H100-80GB (dedicated-002), driver=535.86, cuda=12.0, cudnn=9.8, runtime=2.4.3, container=redwood/infer:v2.1-int8-2026-03-18.

ravi_research: hypothesis: int8 dequant + shard boundary can mis-align rotary index math (RoPE) or the kv offset calculation. rollover when addr == shard_size might be handled differently in quant path.

jin_eng: also try toggling `--prefill-atomic` and `--kv-preserve-offset` flags — if behavior changes it's likely writewrap vs read-offset disagreement.

marta_ml: good idea. i'll run three variants: (A) base, (B) +--prefill-atomic, (C) +--kv-preserve-offset. will log pass/fail counts over 20 runs each and include seed.

marta_ml: quick status: job 452 queued on dedicated-002. will post results ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marta_ml: update (30m): results 20-run batches: A: 12/20 repros, B: 0/20 repros, C: 0/20 repros. interestingly B/C fix it. perf delta for B: -2.1% throughput, C: -0.6%.

ravi_research: seems like a correctness guard (atomic write or offset preservation) is masking a race/rounding scenario in the int8 write path. next steps: add a small unit test that constructs a prefill finishing exactly at shard boundary and asserts no token duplication across quant modes. also verify RoPE index used when reading kv after wrap.

jin_eng: please open a PR with the guard enabled by default behind a perf flag + the test. tag me and @ben_ml for quant review.

ben_ml: on it — i'll review the quant math diffs. also let's add a synthetic eval (perplexity + token-alignment diff) to the longctx regression suite so this doesn't slip.

marta_ml: filing ticket ML-1287, attaching logs and a tiny seed prompt. closing here for now, will link PR when ready. :white_check_mark:
